description: This Java class 'IdempotencyStoreHelper' provides utility methods for managing idempotency keys and command results in the context of HTTP requests and responses within Fineract. It interacts with command source repositories and services, and accesses request context attributes related to command processing.

classes.name: IdempotencyStoreHelper
classes.description: A Spring component that manages idempotency tokens and related command results, providing methods to store command results and determine if specific request or response types are allowed based on content type and status.

methods.name: storeCommandResult
methods.description: Stores the result status code and body for a command identified by commandId, if such a command exists.

methods.name: isAllowedContentTypeResponse
methods.description: Checks if the response content type is JSON or if the response status code indicates success (2xx).

methods.name: isAllowedContentTypeRequest
methods.description: Checks if the request content type is JSON.

methods.name: isStoreIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Determines if the idempotency key should be stored based on request attribute.

methods.name: getCommandId
methods.description: Retrieves the command ID associated with the request from the request context attributes.
